description:
Unlike traditional AI, which mainly classifies or predicts, generative AI creates original outputs based on patterns learned from large datasets. Generative (a special kind of AI that can create things) AI creates new content such as text, images, audio and videos even codes using advanced AI models.

 It’s like giving your computer a magic pencil.

 You tell it: “Draw a dancing dog,” and it draws one!.

 GenAI uses deep learning architectures (Transformers) to generate new content based on probability distributions.

concepts.GPT: A Large Language Model (LLM) that understands and generates human-like text for conversations, content creation, coding, and more.
concepts.DALL·E: An AI model that creates unique images and artwork from natural language descriptions.
concepts.Stable Diffusion: An open-source generative AI model that converts text prompts into high-quality images.
concepts.Gemini: Google's multimodal AI model capable of understanding and generating text, images, audio, video, and code.
concepts.AI Agent: An AI-powered system that can plan, reason, make decisions, and execute actions to achieve specific goals.
concepts.Copilot: Microsoft's AI assistant integrated across Microsoft 365, Windows, GitHub, and business applications.
concepts.Claude: Anthropic's AI assistant designed for helpful, safe, and reliable conversations and reasoning tasks.
